reviews.notes: Severe ESCO subject/commodity fan-out: of 145 rows, ~100 are commodity-templated variants across three families (import export manager, import export specialist, distribution manager) plus a few wholesale-merchant variants. Recommend collapsing each family to its generic anchor (generic 'import export manager', 'import export specialist', and 'distribution manager' all already present). Genuine customs/trade core is small: customs officer, immigration officer, customs and excise officer, hand luggage inspector, import export specialist/manager (generic), forwarding manager, shipping agent, international forwarding operations coordinator, marine cargo/freight inspector. Also heavy transport/logistics contamination (warehouse manager, road/rail/air/maritime operations managers, railway station manager, airport director, air traffic manager, pipeline superintendent, intermodal/supply chain/logistics managers, move manager, purchasing manager, forecast/resource manager, movie distributor) which belong in a Logistics/Transport domain, plus 6 non-customs regulatory inspectors removed above. Domain badly needs de-fanout + splitting logistics out.
